= Geodes =
'''Geodes''' are a special type of ground item.  
They can be collected by walking over them. They can also be dug up with a Geothermal [[Enchanting#tabber-Shovels|enchanted]] shovel. 

== Overview ==
* Each digsite/area (except the Museum) has its own Geode variant.  
* Opening a Geode rolls from that area's deposit loot table, respecting ore rarities.  
* Each Geode also has a flat '''10% chance''' to drop [[Meteor_Shards|shards]].  
* Geodes are '''not deposits''' — they are quick single-roll nodes.  
* All ores obtained from Geodes will have the <span style="color:#B7E6FF;">Crystalline</span> modifier. Crystalline modifier is only obtainable from Geodes.
* Geodes de-spawn after 20 minutes (or when the server decides there are too many objects spawned, whichever comes first).

== Availability ==
* Geodes can spawn in almost every area, except:  
** '''{{The Void}}'''  
** '''{{Infernal Heart}}'''  
** '''{{Museum}}''' 
** '''{{Timelocked Sanctuary}}'''  
* Geodes can also be dug up in ''any'' digsite, including {{The Void}}, {{Infernal Heart}}, and {{Timelocked Sanctuary}}, using a Geothermal-enchanted shovel.
* The Geode Shower [[Events|event]] will cause lots of geodes to spawn in certain locations.

== Collection ==
To collect a Geode:  
# Walk over the geode lying on the ground. <br>&nbsp; - OR -<br>Dig — as slowly as possible — using a Geothermal-enchanted shovel.
# Use the geode from your inventory.

== Loot ==
* Loot is pulled from the '''same rarity table''' as the area's deposit.  
* Rarer ores have the same rarity as they do when panning normally.  
* Flat '''10% chance''' to also grant [[Meteor_Shards|shards]].
